## Summary

Describe the outcome and motivation.

## Validation

- [ ] `just check` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior or the omission is explained.
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs are updated when required.
- [ ] No credentials, tenant data, state, or private operational data is included.

## Operational impact

Describe deployment, migration, rollback, security, or compatibility effects. Use
“None” when the change has no operational impact.
